lines.text: The next day,
Sky is once again alone in the office, working on paperwork.
*Knock, knock*

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Don't tell me...
She quietly stands up and walks to the door.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... Who is it?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I'm back, Miss!
*Beep*
Sky presses the door lock button.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: The door was open?!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I told you, I'm not opening the door unless you follow the proper procedure.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: O-open the door!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Please leave.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Hmph!
Following Sephie's response, the hallway falls silent. There's no sign of anyone outside anymore.
But the next day...
*Knock, knock, knock*

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Miss! Open the door!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: *Sigh...*
Sky presses a button on the intercom.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Please don't make me repeat myself.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I've already said no.

lines.speaker: sephie_op
lines.text: They say even the dead get their wishes granted,

lines.speaker: sephie_op
lines.text: so why can't you grant mine?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... Where did you even learn to talk like that?

lines.speaker: sephie_op
lines.text: On TV.

lines.speaker: sephie_op
lines.text: There's nothing else to do but watch TV all day.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Just what kind of life has she been living...?

lines.speaker: sephie_op
lines.text: Anyway, open the door!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: You still have your whole life ahead of you, Sephie. There'll be plenty of chances to make your wishes come true.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: So please, go home.
Even so, Sephie continues to show up at the office, knocking on the door day after day.
Then, one day...
Sky stares intently at the office door.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: She usually comes by around this time...

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Is she not coming today...?
Just then,
a loud banging comes from the window.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Huh? It's not even windy today, so why is the window—

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Miss!

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Open the window!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: We're on the second floor! How'd you get up here?!

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: There was this long pipe thingy, so I climbed up it.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: A long pipe thingy...?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Wait, don't tell me you climbed up the pipes on the side of the building?!
Sky opens the window.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Get inside, right now!
Sephie climbs through the window and steps into the office.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Hehe, you finally opened—

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: ... Are you mad?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: You look scary.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Yes, I'm really mad.
Sephie hangs her head.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: You wouldn't have let me in otherwise!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: That's still no excuse for doing something so dangerous.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I won't do it again.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: *Sigh...*
Sky's expression softens.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Promise me you won't do anything dangerous again.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... And I'll let you in.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Okay! Pinky promise!
Sephie beams.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: And thank you...

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... What for?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: For worrying about me.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Daddy used to say that

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: you don't worry about someone or get mad at them unless you like them.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: So you were worried about me and got mad at me because you like me.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... I wouldn't quite put it that way.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: So you don't like me?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Not exactly, but...

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I think I could grow to like you, as long as you stop making such a fuss over the paperwork.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Hmph!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Anyway, regardless of how you ended up here,

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: you're still a guest in our office.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Let me get you something to eat, at least.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Do you have a sweet tooth?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Yeah, I like sweets.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: But I can't have any.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: You can't?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: They say I'll get sick if I eat too many sweets.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Well... I suppose that's true. It could cause cavities, after all.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Would you like a sugar-free candy instead?
Sky picks a candy out of the basket on her desk.
Sephie gives a little bow and accepts it.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: It's not sweet...

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: But it's still yummy.
Sephie happily munches on the candy.
Sky watches her quietly for a moment before speaking.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Come to think of it, Sephie...

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: There's something important I haven't asked you yet.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Why are you so determined to get a hot air balloon off the ground, even if it means going this far?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I'm doing it because I want to.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Why do I need a reason to do what I want?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Daddy told me this too...

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Once you've decided to do something,

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: don't overthink it, and just go for it.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: So I'm just doing what I want to do.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: You do it because you want to...
Sky glances at the photo on her desk.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Miss, Miss.
Sephie tugs at Sky's sleeve.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... Yes?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: What's your name, anyway?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: You never told me!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I never got around to introducing myself.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I'm Sky,

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: captain of the Over the Horizon Squad.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Sky...

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Okay, got it.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I'm gonna be coming by every day, so I should at least know your name.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Could you at least try to keep it to once every other day?
From that day on, Sephie visits Sky every day and sticks close to her side.
Sky steps out of the store with shopping bags in both hands,
while Sephie is practically glued to her side.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: You could've just waited for me at the office. Why'd you follow me out here?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I only came out to pick up some office supplies, so I won't be long.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I get so restless staying cooped up inside all the time.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Besides, I like going out and exploring!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: If you'd rather be outside, why not go play with your friends instead of coming to the office?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I like being with you, Sky.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: And if we keep hanging out,

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: maybe you'll let me ride in a hot air balloon someday!
Sephie reaches for the shopping bag Sky is holding.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Hehe, let me carry this for you!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: It's too heavy for you, Sephie.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: And if you think you can get on my good side to get me to say yes, think again.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I'm not going to change my mind over something like that.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: That's weird.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: This always worked in the shows I watched.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Just what kind of shows is she watching...?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: All right, that's enough. Let's head back.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Hup!
Sephie snatches one of the shopping bags,
and takes off running.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: S-Sephie!

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I'll carry this one!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I'm telling you, it's heavy!

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: It's okay! I can carry it!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: O-okay, but stop running!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: What if you trip or bump into something?!

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Seriously, I'm fine—
Just then,
Sephie bumps into a passerby.
Thankfully, they catch her before she falls.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: See, I told you not to run.
Sky rushes toward Sephie.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Good thing he caught you. What if you'd fallen?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Now, go apologize to the gentleman you bumped into.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I'm really sorry. She can be a handful someti—
Sky starts apologizing to the passerby, only to stop short.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... Captain?
